name: FOG Project
description: fogupdater.sh fetches the version check + release tarball with wget --no-check-certificate (plaintext-HTTP SourceForge fallback), then runs installfog.sh -y as root with no signature/hash check → MITM to root RCE. VENDOR-CONFIRMED & FIXED: maintainer patched it to GitHub over enforced HTTPS (PR #1385/#1386); advisory GHSA-qp3r-8mwm-vg6h, CVE pending.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The updater script disables certificate checks for version and tarball downloads, extracts the archive, and runs installfog.sh unattended. No independent payload authentication is present.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.

original_evidence.text: | FOG Project | https://github.com/FOGProject/fogproject.git | 9f3b5a8 / 2026-08-11 | **Y** | Y (admin-triggered upgrade + legacy client-agent pull) | **Y** | **HTTP+HTTPS, TLS validation explicitly DISABLED** | N | hash only (MD5), server-supplied | server-supplied/unpinned | `utils/FOGUpdater/fogupdater.sh:14,17,25,43` — `wget --no-check-certificate` used for both the version-check call to `https://fogproject.org/version/index.php` and the tarball download; stable-channel mirrors are plain `http://*.dl.sourceforge.net` (line 25); downloaded tarball is extracted and `./installfog.sh -y` is executed immediately (no signature check, no hash check on the mirror download). Separately, `packages/web/lib/client/updateclient.class.php:56-113` implements a server-side "ask"/"get" legacy client-updater channel where the FOG client agent fetches an MD5 (`cuMD5`, stored in DB, attacker-controlled if DB/admin compromised) and the file itself from the FOG server with no signature — server IS the trust root. |
